description: This file provides utility functions to find an item by UUID within a list of items conforming to ItemInterface. It defines two functions: FindItem, which returns an optional item, and SureFindItem, which asserts the item exists.

methods.name: export function FindItem<I extends ItemInterface = ItemInterface>(items: I[], uuid: string): I |/ FindItem
methods.description: Locates an item with a specific UUID in a list of items.

methods.name: export function SureFindItem<I extends ItemInterface = ItemInterface>(items: I[], uuid: string):/ SureFindItem
methods.description: Finds an item by UUID and asserts its existence, returning the item or throwing an error if not found.

ctags.name: FindItem
ctags.pattern: /^export function FindItem<I extends ItemInterface = ItemInterface>(items: I[], uuid: string): I |/

ctags.name: SureFindItem
ctags.pattern: /^export function SureFindItem<I extends ItemInterface = ItemInterface>(items: I[], uuid: string):/
